facts.fact: The paper titled 'Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon’s Diet?' is authored by Amal Doua from the Centre for Interdisciplinary Science, University of Leicester.
The paper was published in Volume 6 of the Journal of Interdisciplinary Science Topics in 2017.
The study investigates whether Hiccup can supply enough fish for Toothless, a Night Fury dragon, who requires 13 Icelandic cod and 56 Atlantic salmon each day.
Over twelve days, Toothless would need a total of 716 kg of fish, which equates to Hiccup carrying 828 fish weighing 8592 kg, deemed unrealistic.

result.summary: The paper explores the unrealistic logistics of a teenage boy, Hiccup, supplying sufficient fish to sustain Toothless, a dragon, based on nutritional requirements detailed in the study.

Using an invention which closely resembles a net gun, Hiccup strikes down Toothless during a dragon raid. Toothless’ left caudal fin is severed, rendering him unable to fly out of the sunken area, known as The Cove . Fish are a large component of a dragon’s diet, and Toothless is exclusively dependent on fish for nutrition . This paper investigates whether Hiccup is able to maintain Toothless’ feeding habits while he is trapped in The Cove.
